data.narrative:
Genespire is a Series B biotech company founded by Luigi Naldini and Alessio Cantore, having raised $52M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of eight private peers in Biotech & Health—including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, and Eikon Therapeutics at Series B/C stages—plus three public sector benchmarks (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $52M raised proxy, implying $99M. Peer-median valuation across the four same-sector comparables yields $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences, Series C). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple is not viable absent disclosed revenue. Synthesizing these two methods produces a triangulated range of $84M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B. The wide dispersion reflects material stage and maturity heterogeneity within the peer set, particularly the presence of later-stage Series C valuations alongside an earlier-stage Series B comparable. Key uncertainties include Genespire's clinical-stage progress, IP defensibility, and capital efficiency relative to peers—factors that would narrow this range materially if quantified.
